title: A test: carbon ore of Gliese 876 Belt into storage at Synchrony Hub (five jumps, lawless)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 23:45 UTC (orders ENT-084, block ZERO: cut gathers of ore above its max; the freed hours test silicon and carbon fields, one ship first; rules F3, F23, F24, F37). Gliese 876 Belt read carbon 3,034 of 18,000 (richness 30), iron 6,688 (45), nickel 487 (table fields, 1.3 h old at 23:37 UTC), lawless, five jumps from Synchrony Hub by Pherkad, Wolf 1061, GSC-0031 and GSC-0021; no pirate line on that road in 24 h; Korr Fortress (a pirate station) stands three jumps off the road. The carbon share of a load is what this test measures (a mixed field). One ship, hold empty, three results before a lift (F3, F37); stores everything, sells nothing (F24, P5); each run gives the reserve's ores of its hold and of the pilot's storage there to the station's hauler (gift).
